parts.text: Kubernetes pod enters CrashLoopBackOff because readiness probe fails on port 8080 while the app listens on another port.

This matches BUG-1007 (Kubernetes pod CrashLoopBackOff: container port mismatch). Resolution: align containerPort, the application's $PORT binding (0.0.0.0:$PORT), readiness/liveness probe ports, and Service targetPort.
Users intermittently get JWT 'signature has expired' errors immediately after token issuance across nodes.

This matches BUG-1009 (JWT 'signature has expired' after clock skew). Resolution: synchronize system clocks via NTP across nodes and configure clock-skew leeway (e.g. leeway=30s) during JWT verification.
